sentences.text: Author: Manoj Kumar Garg Bench: Manoj Kumar Garg
HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Misc. Bail No. 9739/2018 1.
Govind Gurjar S/o Sh. Bheemraj Gurjar, Aged About 21  Years, R/o Vill Sakroda, Kunwariya, Dist. Rajsamand.
2. Prakash Gurjar S/o Sh. Udayram Gurjar, Aged About 23  Years, R/o Vill Sakroda, Kunwariya, Dist. Rajsamand.

----Petitioners  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Ramesh Purohit For Respondent(s) : Mr. As Rathore, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Judgment / Order 06/10/2018 The matter comes up on an application for deleting the name of respondent No.3 Laxman Gurjar S/o Shri Mathuralal Gurjar from the array of the petitioners of the bail application.
For the reasons stated in the application, the application is allowed.
The name of the petitioner No.3 Laxman Gurjar S/o Shri Mathuralal Gurjar is deleted from the array of the petitioners of the bail application.
Amended cause title filed along with the application is taken on record.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties on the bail application and perused the material available on record.

The petitioners have been arrested in connection with FIR No.198/2018 of Police Station Bhupalpura, District Udaipur for the offence punishable under Sections 420 IPC, Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1980, Section 80 of Trade & (2 of 2) [CRLMB-9739/2018]
Merchandise Act and Section 63 of Copy Right Act.

They have preferred this bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
Counsel for the petitioners submits that challan of the case has already been filed and no investigation is pending.
The accused-petitioners are in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficient long time to be concluded.

Therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the Govind Gurjar vs State Of Rajasthan on 6 October, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165022918/
1 accused-petitioners.

sentences.text: Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.

Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it just and proper to grant bail to the accused petitioners under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

Accordingly, the bail application filed under Sec.439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is directed that petitioners (1) Govind Gurjar S/o Sh. Bheemraj Gurjar and (2) Prakash Gurjar S/o Sh. Udayram Gurjar shall be released on bail in connection with FIR No.198/2018 of Police Station Bhupalpura,
District Udaipur provided they execute a personal bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sound and solvent sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of learned trial court for their appearance before that court on each and every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till the completion of the trial.
(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J Ms/-91 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
